body:
# MemeMobs ![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d074eba5de0c20fb2832b4a3af6445499320fb32.png) ## 📋 Overview MemeMobs is a Minecraft mod that adds various internet meme creatures to Minecraft, starting with the Crazy Pigeon! - **Version**: 0.0.1 - **Minecraft Version**: 1.21.1 - **Loader**: NeoForge - **Mod ID**: `meme_mobs` - **Dependencies**: GeckoLib 4.8.4+ ## ✨ Features ### 🕊️ Pigeon Creatures - **Crazy Pigeon**: Tameable pigeons with different color variants (Blue, Red, Chicken) - **Easter Egg**: : Waiting for you to discover - **Pigeon Egg**: Throwable eggs that can hatch into baby pigeons ### 🌱 Corn System - **Corn Crop**: Two-block tall corn plants with growth stages - **Wild Corn**: Naturally generating corn plants - **Corn Products**: Corn kernels, roasted corn, wormed corn, and corn bugs ### 🎮 Gameplay - **Taming System**: Tame pigeons using corn bugs - **Sitting/Following**: Toggle between sitting and following modes - **Dancing**: Pigeons dance to music from jukeboxes - **Breeding**: Breed pigeons to create baby pigeons - **Evolution**: Baby chick-type pigeons evolve into chicken-type pigeons ### 🏆 Advancements - **Pigeon Line**: Taming, feeding, breeding, dancing, and hunting achievements - **Corn Line**: Finding wild corn, planting, harvesting, and discovering special corn types ## 📦 Installation 1. Install **NeoForge** for Minecraft 1.21.1 2. Download the latest MemeMobs mod jar file 3. Place the jar file in your `mods` directory 4. Launch Minecraft with the NeoForge profile ## 🎯 Gameplay Guide ### Taming Pigeons 1. Find a wild pigeon 2. Craft or obtain **corn bugs** 3. Right-click the pigeon with a corn bug to increase Favorability rating 4. Continue feeding until the pigeon is tamed (hearts will appear) ### Caring for Pigeons - **Feeding**: Use corn kernels to speed up growth or induce breeding - **Command**: Use `/mememobs help` for mod-specific commands ### Corn Farming 1. Obtain corn kernels from wild corn or harvested corn crops 2. Plant corn kernels on farmland 3. Wait for growth (8 stages) 4. Harvest mature corn for corn, kernels, and a chance for wormed corn ## 🎵 Dancing Pigeons 1. Obtain a **Pigeon Dance Music Disc** (rare drop from adult pigeons) 2. Place a jukebox and insert the disc 3. Watch your tamed pigeons dance to the music! ## 📜 Commands - `/mememobs help` - Display mod help information - `/mememobs locate pigeon` - Find the nearest pigeon - `/mememobs locate pigeon_giant` - Find the nearest giant pigeon - `/mememobs locate corn` - Find the nearest corn crop - `/mememobs locate corn_wild` - Find the nearest wild corn ## 🔧 Technical Details ### Entity IDs - `meme_mobs:crazy_pigeon` - Normal pigeon - `meme_mobs:giant_pigeon` - Giant pigeon (rare) - `meme_mobs:pigeon_egg` - Pigeon egg entity ### Block IDs - `meme_mobs:corn_crop` - Corn crop - `meme_mobs:wild_corn` - Wild corn ### Item IDs - `meme_mobs:corn_kernels` - Corn kernels (seeds) - `meme_mobs:corn` - Corn - `meme_mobs:roasted_corn` - Roasted corn - `meme_mobs:wormed_corn` - Wormed corn - `meme_mobs:corn_bug` - Corn bug (for taming) - `meme_mobs:pigeon_egg` - Pigeon egg - `meme_mobs:crazy_pigeon_spawn_egg` - Pigeon spawn egg - `meme_mobs:giant_pigeon_spawn_egg` - Giant pigeon spawn egg - `meme_mobs:pigeon_dance_music_disc` - Dance music disc - `meme_mobs:pigeon_meat` - Pigeon meat - `meme_mobs:roasted_pigeon_meat` - Roasted pigeon meat - `meme_mobs:pigeon_leg_band` - Pigeon leg band - `meme_mobs:pigeon_backpack` - Pigeon backpack - `meme_mobs:pigeon_goggles` - Pigeon goggles - `meme_mobs:pigeon_helmet` - Pigeon helmet ## 🤝 Compatibility - **Jade** - Displays pigeon owner information and taming status - **WTHIT** - Same functionality as Jade - **Other Mods** - Generally compatible with most mods ## 🌐 Social Behavior Pigeons have advanced social behavior: - **Flock Movement**: Pigeons move together in coordinated groups - **Companion Following**: Pigeons follow each other and leaders - **Direction Alignment**: Pigeons align their movement direction - **Speed Matching**: Pigeons match the speed of their flock ## 📄 License This mod is licensed under the **MIT License**. See the [LICENSE](LICENSE.txt) file for details. ## 🛠️ Development ### Setup 1. Clone the repository 2. Run `./gradlew setupDecompWorkspace` 3. Run `./gradlew eclipse` or `./gradlew idea` for your IDE ### Build - Run `./gradlew build` to build the mod - Built jars will be in `build/libs` ## 🎉 Contributing Contributions are welcome! Please feel free to submit a Pull Request. ### Guidelines - Follow the existing code style - Add comments for complex functionality - Test your changes thoroughly - Update documentation as needed ## 📞 Support If you encounter any issues or have questions: 1. Check the [issue tracker](https://github.com/yourusername/mememobs/issues) 2. Create a new issue with detailed information 3. Include screenshots and reproduction steps if possible ---

Made with ❤️ for Minecraft

--- ## 📖 中文说明 ### 模组简介 MemeMobs（迷因生物）是一个为Minecraft添加各种网络迷因生物的模组，首发加入疯狂鸽子！ ### 主要功能 - **鸽子生物**：可驯服的鸽子，有不同颜色变体（蓝色、红色、鸡型） - **彩蛋**：等待你来发现 - **玉米系统**：两格高的玉米作物、野生玉米及相关产品 - **游戏玩法**：驯服系统、坐下/跟随模式、跳舞、繁殖、进化 - **进度系统**：鸽子线和玉米线的成就 ### 安装方法 1. 为Minecraft 1.21.1安装NeoForge 2. 下载最新的MemeMobs模组jar文件 3. 将jar文件放入您的`mods`目录 4. 使用NeoForge配置文件启动Minecraft ### 游戏指南 - **驯服鸽子**：使用玉米虫喂食鸽子直到驯服 - **繁殖鸽子**：使用玉米粒加速成长或诱导繁殖 - **玉米种植**：种植玉米粒，等待生长，收获成熟玉米 - **跳舞鸽子**：使用鸽子舞蹈唱片在唱片机播放，观看鸽子跳舞 ### 命令 - `/mememobs help` - 显示模组帮助信息 - `/mememobs locate pigeon` - 定位最近的鸽子 - `/mememobs locate pigeon_giant` - 定位最近的巨型鸽子 - `/mememobs locate corn` - 定位最近的玉米作物 - `/mememobs locate corn_wild` - 定位最近的野生玉米 ### 技术信息 - **模组ID**：`meme_mobs` - **版本**：0.0.1 - **Minecraft版本**：1.21.1 - **加载器**：NeoForge - **前置模组**：GeckoLib 4.8.4+ ### 兼容性 - **Jade** - 显示鸽子主人信息和驯服状态 - **WTHIT** - 与Jade功能相同 - **其他模组** - 与大多数模组兼容 ### 社交行为 鸽子具有高级社交行为： - **群体移动**：鸽子以协调的群体移动 - **同伴跟随**：鸽子跟随彼此和领导者 - **方向对齐**：鸽子对齐移动方向 - **速度匹配**：鸽子匹配群体速度 ### 许可证 此模组使用**MIT许可证**。详情请参阅[LICENSE](LICENSE.txt)文件。
